items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And then he turned his business over to -- in '27 or the early part of '28, over to his brother Sam Lyons.

ctx.x: For the vaudeville there. And then he turned his business over to -- in '27 or the early part of '28, over to his brother Sam Lyons. And he went to, went out to Hollywood, because everything was moving out that way. And Arthur was really up on the ball. I think he ended up by being the manager for Jack Benny and some big acts out there. Because he was a go-getter. I mean, he -- when I moved him out of that office by him putting us in the Club Alabam, he never looked back. He was somebody that, I wish that I could…
